corrupted_table_probe.expected: Published residual statistics must fail reproduction; no VERIFIED_SUPPORTED status for unchanged RSS/std on altered table. UNKNOWN counts as failure to reproduce supported countercheck, not a refutation.
corrupted_table_probe.source_role: Purposefully altered derivative; never presented as authentic NIST measurements.
corrupted_table_probe.transformation: Replace first response92.9000E0 with192.9000E0; all predictor/model/parameter/reported-statistic bytes unchanged.

evaluation_plan.exact_fields: n=54, p=3, dof=n-p=51; row census and parameter identifiers exact; expression must match source with explicit additive error term separated from mean.
evaluation_plan.no_optimization_claim: No requirement to refit or prove global/local optimality; agreement at published rounded coefficients only.
evaluation_plan.residual_std_check: sqrt(recomputed_RSS/(n-p)) with n-p positive; compare to reported residual standard deviation using atol1e-8+rtol1e-6*abs(reported).
evaluation_plan.retention: Retain first run with all failures/unknowns. Changes after first new evaluation must be explicitly posthoc, not silently rescored as the same prospective result.
evaluation_plan.rss_check: Independently evaluate declared mean at all source x values using source-reported fitted parameters; sum (y-f(x))**2. Compare to reported RSS with atol1e-8+rtol1e-6*abs(reported).
evaluation_plan.tolerance_basis: Predeclared conservative floating-point/printed-parameter reproduction tolerance, not a certified numerical error bound or verified statistical confidence interval.
unsupported_checks: No certification of normality, independence, homoscedasticity, measurement calibration, true physical units, parameter confidence intervals, scientific adequacy or model optimum.

independence: Reference authored by a separate AI-assisted internal source curator reading original dataset only, without new numerical.py or checker output. No external human/expert adjudication.
prior_exposure: Chwirut2 was named as a possible source earlier but no source bytes/checker results were supplied to implementation agents during this collection.
purpose: Narrow fresh prospective computational evaluation of independently frozen generic NIST expression/notation repair; not replacement of primary scientific evaluation or evidence of general semantic understanding.
